02 / WORKFLOW

From model to stock folders

Four steps
01

Load a STEP

Choose a multi-body STEP or load the example tab. The file is analyzed in your browser.

02

Check each body

Filter by category or search by name. Select Inspect to rotate a body and read the detection evidence.

03

Resolve reviews

Use Assembly position to locate a body, then Focus selected for nearby context. Correct its category or thickness and mark it verified. Check the largest flat face preview against CAD.

04

Download the ZIP

Choose Download sorted STEP ZIP for the 3D solids, or Download flat-face DXF ZIP for 2D cut outlines with holes and tube copes. Bent parts need an unfolded blank before cutting.

i
Verify before fabrication

Geometry-based detection can be uncertain around weldnuts, complex blends, or unusual walls. Check the result in source CAD before ordering stock or cutting parts.
